pull_request.title: Infrastructure: document agent roles and final sign-off authority
pull_request.head: chore/agent-roles-signoff
pull_request.body:
Add the eight declared agent roles to the root README with short address names and concise responsibility summaries. Record `asalzburger-review` as the final human sign-off authority in the README and ADR-002, including formal M0 closure.

Update the existing M0 governance tracking metadata and include the curated session records. M0 remains pending and ADR-002 remains DRAFT; the authority assignment records no approval decision. PROJECT.md and CI policy have no changes in this PR.

Related: ADR-002 and TASK-GOVERNANCE. No linked issue exists for this direct request.

- [x] Chore: no chore work item, review round or PR entry was added to progress tracking; the existing governance metadata was corrected.
- [x] Local checks passed: 25 dashboard/update-policy tests, 15 logging/documentation tests and 14 JavaScript assertions.
- [x] Dashboard validation/build, session validation (31 records) and whitespace checks passed; the existing chore policy accepts the actual changed paths.
- [x] Preserved human approval requirements and recorded the authority assignment separately from approval decisions.
